protocol.time_step: The capillary_wave_2d step shared by all levels (decision D10): the largest dt within the one-sided capillary limit sqrt(rho h^3/(4 pi gamma)) of lambda/h = 64 that divides the run into 100 output intervals, dt = 5.5027e-4, 2900 steps; 0.12, 0.35 and 1.00 times the limit of lambda/h = 16, 32, 64.
protocol.time_step_study: lambda/h = 32 at dt, dt/2, dt/4 (generate_case.py --dt-divisor 1, 2, 4); the dt run is the lambda/h = 32 run of the spatial study. Richardson extrapolation of omega and beta to dt -> 0 (order from the three steps, limit from the two smallest) gives the time error e_t(dt) of the shared step, which is removed from every spatial-study frequency and damping rate. The time-step study itself is reported, not gated.
protocol.reference: Prosperetti initial-value solution (capillary_wave_2d/prosperetti_reference.py), fitted with the same damped-cosine model on the same output times as the simulation
protocol.note: Same physical case, metrics and criteria as capillary_wave_2d, so the fitted and unfitted M3 results are judged alike; only the time-error removal (D10, as in fitted_sloshing_2d) is added. Definitions are in README.md.

criteria.definition: |omega_sim - e_t^omega(dt) - omega_ref| / omega_ref. omega_sim is the angular frequency of the least-squares fit exp(-beta t)(c1 cos(omega t) + c2 sin(omega t)) to the exact cos(kx) coefficient a_h(t) of the P1 free surface over all outputs including t = 0; omega_ref is the same fit to Prosperetti's a(t) at the same times; e_t^omega(dt) from the time-step study.
criteria.order_method: least-squares slope of log(error) against log(lambda/h) over order_levels; pairwise orders are reported
criteria.source: Tracker section 5, M3 working criterion (decision D1): frequency error <= 2% at lambda/h = 32 with convergence over 16/32/64, as in capillary_wave_2d/tolerances.json (order >= 1); time error removed as decided in D10.

criteria.definition: |beta_sim - e_t^beta(dt) - beta_ref| / beta_ref, beta the amplitude decay rate of the same two fits and e_t^beta(dt) from the time-step study.
criteria.order_method: least-squares slope of log(error) against log(lambda/h) over order_levels; pairwise orders are reported
criteria.source: Tracker section 5, M3 working criterion (decision D1): damping error <= 5% at lambda/h = 32 with convergence over 16/32/64, also applied at the finest level as in decision D12; identical to capillary_wave_2d/tolerances.json.

criteria.definition: max over all outputs (and t = 0) of |A(t) - A(0)| / A(0), A the exact area of the current liquid mesh (reference points plus mesh displacement), A(0) that of the initial mesh (the region under the sampled P1 surface).
criteria.at_level: each protocol run (spatial and time-step studies)
criteria.source: Tracker section 5 volume limit 1e-4 (M1-M3, decision D1), gated on the maximum deviation over the run (decision D11); as capillary_wave_2d/tolerances.json and fitted_sloshing_2d/tolerances.json.
